title: What do I need to shift my mind away from so that I am seeking His Kingdom first?
What are practical ways for me to remember that it is the Lord who gives me power?
What are 3 things I can do to sow into the lives of others this year? How can I give?

What are 3 things you can do as a FAMILY this year? Include things you can do as a family, with your spouse, children, grandparents, etc. that focus on seeking His Kingdom and fostering those relationships. Also, include things as they relate to your church family or are communityfocused.
What are 3 things I want to avoid this year? What situations or activities typically pull you away from being Kingdom-focused?
What things are deemed a priority, or MOST important, this year? These are the things/commitments/relationships worth sacrificing for.
What things are deemed LEAST important and not a priority? These are the things/commitments you should let go of.
